//: Two path aliases, both pointing at apps/web/src, for two different readers (SPA-181). `#web/*` is the worker's own spelling of a crossing into the web tree — the eslint worker zone allows it for lib/ and test/ and lists every specifier that uses it. `#/*` is never written in this package (the zone bans it here) and exists for the web modules the worker loads through `#web/*`, which import each other as `#/lib/…`: tsx resolves `#/` from tsconfig `paths` and reads one tsconfig per process, this one when the worker runs, so without the entry the first web module loaded would die on its first `#/` specifier. Under tsc the same entry resolves those modules' imports exactly as apps/web's own package.json `imports` does. Both entries go when lib/ has moved into core.
